Name: Vulpix Dog Replacement
Author: onjulraz
Description:
[center]This is a mod made for a close friend.  It will replace the default dog with a Vulpix.  

[size=6]Vulpix Dog Replacement[/size]
by onjulraz


[size=5]What is it?
[/size]This mod replaces the default dog and dog portrait with Vulpix!
I'm hoping to add sound in the next couple days. 

[size=5]Install[/size]
[url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
Requires Content Patcher!

Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
Run the game using SMAPI.

---

To uninstall, remove the folder from /Mods.


[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
It just works
but no seriously, I use a lot of mods and it seems to play nice.  Please let me know if you find a bug.
